reasons.text: Stored replay responses are capped at 64 kB of body

reasons.text: Log the key hash, never the raw header

reasons.text: The rate limit is 20 submits per customer per minute
reasons.why: the largest wholesale customer peaks at 12 per minute

reasons.text: A replayed request returns the stored response with status 200, not 409
reasons.why: the mobile client treats 409 as a failed checkout and shows an error

reasons.text: Idempotency keys expire after 72 hours
reasons.why: the payment provider retries webhooks for up to 48 hours and we keep a day of margin

reasons.text: Keep the v1 submit route alive until 2027-01-15

reasons.text: The key is the Idempotency-Key header hashed together with the customer id
reasons.why: two customers can send the same header value by accident

reasons.text: Use a partial unique index on (customer_id, key_hash) where expired_at is null
reasons.why: a full unique index blocked reuse of a key after expiry

reasons.text: Migrations run as a separate job before the rollout, never at boot
reasons.why: three replicas booting together raced on the same migration in staging

reasons.text: Integration tests run against a real Postgres 17 container, not pg-mem
reasons.why: pg-mem does not support partial unique indexes

reasons.text: Order totals are stored in integer cents
reasons.why: float totals drifted by one cent on orders with 7 or more lines

reasons.text: Idempotency keys live in the orders table, not in Redis
reasons.why: a key must survive a cache flush, and Redis is flushed on every deploy
